lines.intro: A fizzy crystal mole pops up from the cavern sand, paws sparkling with purple dust!
lines.command: How can Fae calm the glimmering mole?

soothe.great: Fae hums a steady lullaby. The mole's little nose twitches and its goggles gleam softly!
soothe.good: Fae speaks softly. The mole pauses its digging to listen.
soothe.miss: The mole scratches the sand so loudly it misses Fae's song.

play.great: Maddie digs a playful little paw-scoop, and the mole cheers with a happy squeak!
play.good: Maddie taps a sparkly pebble. The mole peeks over its goggles.
play.miss: Maddie hops on a tiny mound. The mole huffs and ducks down low.

cast.great: Sue lowers her shiny ribbon bobber. The mole thinks it's a treasure and beams!
cast.good: Sue's bobber glints in the crystal light. The mole reaches out a paw.
cast.miss: Sue's bobber bounces off a rock. The mole turns back to its gravel pile.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles three shiny quartz stones. The mole claps its big digging paws!
juggle.good: Jordan spins a smooth pebble in the air. The mole watches it twinkle.
juggle.miss: Jordan drops a pebble with a clink. The mole tuts like a tiny gem expert.

lines.snack: Fae offers a crunchy trail snack. The mole crunches happily, tail wiggling!
lines.burst: The mole flings a fizzy spray of glittery cave dust and pebbles!

burstResult.great: Fae hops cleanly over every glittery puff!
burstResult.good: Fae dodges most of the cave dust with a quick step.
burstResult.miss: POOF! Glittery crystal dust lands right on Fae's shoes.

lines.soothed: The mole polishes its favorite quartz crystal and smiles a shy, cozy smile.
lines.rest: Fae is dusty and tired. Time for a quick breather.
lines.run: Fae tiptoes past the sand mound. The mole goes back to sorting pebbles.
